statement:
∀ {E : Type ?u.3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type ?u.4} [DecidableEq ι]
  (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → E),
  Orthonormal ℝ e →
    ∀ (f : E) (t : ι → ℝ),
      ‖f - ∑ i ∈ s, t i • e i‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 - ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2 + ∑ i ∈ s, (inner ℝ (e i) f - t i) ^ 2

goal.text: ‖f - ∑ i ∈ s, t i • e i‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 - ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2 + ∑ i ∈ s, (inner ℝ (e i) f - t i) ^ 2
goal.rhs: ‖f‖ ^ 2 - ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2 + ∑ i ∈ s, (inner ℝ (e i) f - t i) ^ 2
goal.lhs: ‖f - ∑ i ∈ s, t i • e i‖ ^ 2

atoms: ‖f - ∑ i ∈ s, t i • e i‖
∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2
∑ i ∈ s, (inner ℝ (e i) f - t i) ^ 2
